Residents of Birnin Tudu community in Gummi Local Government Area of Zamfara State said they killed more than 30 bandits during a three-day confrontation after armed men invaded the community.

Read more: https://dailytrust.com/zamfara-community-fights-back/

BREAKING: Bandits reportedly intercepted a vehicle conveying passengers returning from Sokoto city and fatally shot all the occupants in the vehicle. 
🚗 

The incident occurred along the road to Isa Local Government Area of Sokoto State.
